messages:
Ravi: quick sync on the autoscale controls — I pushed a small variant to the panel branch. Can we do a micro-UX pass on wording + keyboard/a11y? Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc (file 'autoscale-controls_v4')
Elena: saw it. First pass: the min/max inputs look tight on mobile. We should allow the numeric field to expand and wrap helper text under on small breakpoints.
Jon: UX point: the burst affordance reads as a separate toggle + dropdown for burst size. That felt redundant. Maybe a single toggle that reveals an input: 'Enable burst capacity' -> reveals 'Burst limit (GPUs)'.
Priya: Accessibility: screen reader users need the relationship between Min/Max and SLO slider to be explicit. Suggest `aria-describedby` on the slider that references the min/max labels. Also add `role=group` for the whole capacity control with `aria-label='Capacity settings for pool'`.
Ravi: Good call. Elena, can you mock the responsive wrap?
Elena: will do. Also re: copy, current microcopy 'Burst applies per-pool' is ambiguous. Change to 'Burst limit applies per GPU pool and is billed at the burst rate.' Short variant: 'Per-pool burst; billed separately.'
Jon: For keyboard flow: when burst is enabled and the burst input appears, focus should move into the input. Also pressing ESC should collapse it back and return focus to the toggle.
Priya: Make sure the burst input has `inputmode='numeric'` and pattern so mobile shows numeric keypad. Also announce changes with `aria-live='assertive'` when enabling/disabling burst since it can affect billing.
Ravi: Billing announcement is sensitive; maybe 'assertive' is too loud. Use `polite` but include a short phrase: 'Burst enabled; billing may increase during bursts.'
Elena: Visual contrast: the SLO slider track uses the same color as disabled text in dark mode. Need to pick a token with better contrast, and ensure the thumb has a distinct focus ring.
Jon: Copy suggestion: the min/max steppers show 'GPUs' as the unit, but users asked for 'vGPU' vs 'GPU' in dedicated deployments. We should make the unit a variable token tied to deployment type. Fallback to 'GPU' when unknown.
Priya: Testing notes: QA-bot found that when we programmatically set max < min for a moment during autosave, the UI shows a red flash but doesn't prevent submission. We should validate before submit and show inline error 'Max must be >= Min'.
design-bot: Created ticket UI-6712 and linked Figma. Due 2026-04-08.
Ravi: Action list: Elena handle responsive wrapping + copy variants; Jon handle keyboard focus/esc behavior + combobox interactions for pool selector; Priya add aria descriptions + live region + numeric input attributes; I'll make unit token change for Dedicated parity and add validation for min/max.
Elena: I'll add the compact copy for small cards and a slightly longer helper for full details panel.
Jon: Regarding pool selector: it currently filters by name only. We should include tags like 'capacity:high' and 'location' in search. Also make the selected pool chip read as 'Pool: <name> (autoscale on/off)'.
Priya: I'll draft the aria patterns and a short PR description with test steps for screen readers.
Ravi: Please post PR links here. I'll coordinate post-merge staging test.
Jon: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/9012 (keyboard + pool search)
Elena: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/9015 (responsive copy variants)
Priya: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/9018 (a11y + live region + numeric input attrs)
Ravi: I've added unit token change in PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/9020 and validation fix.
QA-bot: Ran smoke tests on branch; failing test: autosave race causes transient max<min state. See logs: `AssertionError: max >= min` on autosave.js:102
Ravi: I'll add a debounce and server-side guard. Thanks QA-bot.
Elena: One last micro-copy thought: helper for SLO guardrail currently 'SLO slider reduces requests to meet target' -> maybe 'SLO guardrail limits incoming requests to maintain latency targets; requests may be routed to fallback pools.'
Jon: Agree. Short label: 'SLO guardrail — may route to fallback pools'.
Priya: All good from an a11y standpoint once PRs land. I'll run NVDA + VoiceOver passes on staging.
Ravi: Great. Merge on green and let's schedule a quick 15-min staging test next week. Thanks everyone :rocket:
